question: How many pots of Vidyeśvara nature must be placed around the principal arrangement?
premises: Eight pots are to be placed.
These pots are of the nature of the Vidyeśvaras.
inference: Eight pots identified with the Vidyeśvaras must be placed around the arrangement.
plain_english: Having placed eight pots of the nature of the Vidyeśvaras all around.
